description:
Crucible is a native client for your Plex Media Server on iPhone, iPad and Apple TV. It is built to feel like part of the system: the system player, native menus and context menus, Liquid Glass on the newest software.

SKIP WHAT DOESN'T MATTER
Essentials hides the anime-only episodes of long shows, the ones that adapt no manga chapter: Dragon Ball Super goes from 131 episodes to 110, or 83 if you've seen the two films it retells, and Up Next follows. The guides come from Crucible Guides, an open dataset (CC BY-SA). Skip Recap and Skip Preview read your files' own chapters, and Spoiler Shield hides what you haven't seen yet.

PICK UP WHERE YOU LEFT OFF
Home opens on a Resume hero, then Continue Watching, Up Next and Recently Added. Library grids have filters for Unwatched and In Progress, genre and sort, an A–Z scrubber and folder browsing for unindexed content. Search groups results by type with a Top Result.

A PLAYER THAT RESPECTS YOUR TIME
Skip Intro and Skip Credits from Plex markers, audio and subtitle menus, adjustable speed, lock screen controls and Up Next that rolls the next episode as the credits start and carries on through the end of a season. On iPhone and iPad: Picture-in-Picture and background audio. Direct play when your device can handle the file, automatic transcoding when it can't.

MADE FOR IPAD
A sidebar with every Plex library, layouts that fit every window from Slide Over to a full 13-inch screen, and several windows at once: open any title in its own window from its menu, or drag its card to the edge of the screen. With a Magic Keyboard, a full menu bar and shortcuts: Command-1 to 4 for the tabs, Command-F to search, Space to play, S to skip the intro, N for the next episode.

MADE FOR THE COUCH
The Apple TV app is built for the Siri Remote: a cinematic Home that follows focus, one tab per library, native context menus, search, and Top Shelf with Continue Watching and Up Next. Liquid Glass on tvOS 26.

TAKE IT OFFLINE
On iPhone and iPad, download movies, seasons or single episodes in the quality you pick. Transfers continue in the background, stay on Wi-Fi by default and, on iPhone, show a Live Activity on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island. Offline playback uses the same player.

KNOW YOUR VIEWING
Watch History grouped by day, Statistics with streaks, heatmaps, binges and taste built from your own Plex history, and a Year in Review poster you can share.

FREE TO USE, CRUCIBLE PRO TO GO FURTHER
Browsing, search and playback are free on iPhone, iPad and Apple TV, and so is the Statistics view for the last week. Crucible Pro unlocks unlimited offline downloads, the full Statistics screen with every range and library filter, the Year in Review poster and Top Shelf. Pay once for lifetime access, or subscribe yearly. One purchase covers iPhone, iPad and Apple TV, and Family Sharing is on.

TRY IT WITHOUT A SERVER
No Plex server yet? Choose Try the demo on the welcome screen to explore a fictional library with everything unlocked, guided by a short tour.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No sign-up, no ads, no analytics. Crucible talks to plex.tv and the server you choose, downloads the episode guides as one file that is the same for everyone, and records Crucible Pro purchases with an anonymous Midgar ID, with no sign-up.

OPEN SOURCE
Crucible is free software under GPL-3.0: https://github.com/guitaripod/Crucible

Crucible needs a Plex Media Server. Plex requires a Plex Pass or Remote Watch Pass to stream from your server away from home. Crucible is an independent app and is not made by, endorsed by or affiliated with Plex, Inc. Plex is a trademark of Plex, Inc.

Crucible Pro Annual: billed yearly at the price shown in the app. The subscription renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the period. Manage it in your Apple Account settings.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://midgarcorp.cc/crucible/privacy
promotionalText: New: Essentials skips the anime-only episodes of long shows, and Skip Recap and Skip Preview read your files' own chapters. Native on iPhone, iPad and Apple TV.
whatsNew:
Essentials: long anime can now skip their anime-only episodes, the ones that adapt no chapter of the manga, starting with Dragon Ball, Dragon Ball Z and Dragon Ball Super. The show page offers it once and says how much time it saves; the Episodes button switches between All Episodes and Skip Anime-Only, hides the episodes that retell films you've seen, and lists the skipped ones, and a long press keeps any episode. Up Next and Continue follow your choice. The guides come from Crucible Guides, an open dataset built from fan wikis (CC BY-SA) and checked every week.

Skip Recap, Skip Preview and Skip Ending: when a file's chapters are named (Recap, Previously On, Next Episode Preview, Ending, OP, ED), the player offers to skip them beside Skip Intro and Skip Credits, and downloads keep them. A recording's commercial break now says Skip Commercial.

Spoiler Shield, in the Episodes menu, hides the titles, synopses and stills of the episodes you haven't watched. Shows without a guide can filter to each season's best-rated episodes.

Crucible Server, free and optional: install it on the computer with Plex, scan the code it shows, and a show you've been watching offers Previously On, a short recap of your last episodes written by a model on your own hardware from their subtitles, checked so it never names anyone the episodes didn't. Nothing leaves your network. Settings, Server & Connection, Crucible Server. Then bring your Apple TV along: choose Pair with iPhone on the TV and tap Allow, or scan the code the TV shows.

Subtitles are real subtitle tracks now instead of being burned into the picture, so turning them on and off is instant: Off is remembered for the show and its next episode, the player's menu has Subtitles and Audio, and detail screens start on the subtitle your server picks for you.

The lock screen and Control Center keep their controls from one episode to the next, Control Center changes the speed, and the player shows the title and episode above the video.

Libraries take the shape of their artwork: Other Videos shows each video's frame at its own shape, in two columns or one at Large on iPhone and three on iPad, episodes in Browse Folders are 16:9 stills and playlists are square, while poster libraries look as before.

Home's Up Next names each episode and marks one that just arrived NEW and a new season NEW SEASON.

A week of Crucible Pro, on us: watch a film or episode to the end and unlimited downloads, every Statistics range, the Year in Review poster and Top Shelf on Apple TV are open for seven days, once per device. Nothing to sign up for and nothing is charged.

Crucible now speaks German, Spanish, French, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Brazilian Portuguese, and Simplified and Traditional Chinese, on iPhone, iPad and Apple TV. Statistics also show your busiest hour in your device's clock format.

More of Plex, on iPhone, iPad and Apple TV.
- When a movie or the last episode of a show ends, titles like it wait on screen; pick a movie and it plays right away
- Autoplay Next Episode now starts the next episode at the credits on its own, on Apple TV too
- Switch between the profiles of your Plex Home, with their PIN
- Rate any title in half stars, sort a library by Your Rating, and rate what you just watched from Home
- Build playlists from any title's menu, then play or shuffle them
- Browse collections, open a cast member's titles, and watch trailers and extras
- A sleep timer, chapters, Stream Info, quality for home, away and cellular, and languages remembered per show
- For server owners: Manage titles and libraries (Fix Match, Edit Details, artwork, Show Settings, scans), stop a stream, and a Server Dashboard
- Crucible now moves between your home network, Tailscale and remote connections on its own as you come and go, picks a playing stream back up on the new connection, and lets you choose a connection in Server & Connection
